Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise Chinese software sequence diagram, portrait, white background, clean professional engineering documentation, excellent legible Simplified Chinese sans-serif typography. Match a companion diagram style: P: Prefill blue header on the left, Router charcoal header at center, D: Decode green header on the right; light gray vertical lifelines; thin blue arrow lines for control messages; thick green rightward arrow P→D for actual KV data; yellow/orange rounded local-operation boxes; red hand-drawn-style elliptical rings only around requested focal stages; purple independent test box when specified. Do not draw decorative art, monitors, networks or characters. Clear arrowheads and no overlapping labels. Output one standalone image. This is the CURRENT SHORT PROMPT PUSH workflow (not pull), and P is the transfer initiator. Neither D→P acquire reading lease nor Router→D pull occurs. P Prefill and D receive preparation execute concurrently; registration of target meta may precede or follow P Prefill completion. Main checks happen in P, not D. The two participant metadata objects are P source (read locations) and D target (write locations). Ensure P-side checks physically sit on the LEFT lifeline. Draw simplified control flow, omit HTTP responses and Router's generation control request explicitly in a small footnote. Chinese text must render clearly.
Title exactly: "Push：元信息检查发生在哪里？"
Subtitle: "当前短 Prompt 流程 · 已完成 P/D 配对 · 时间从上往下"
Top: columns P / Router / D.
A pale band labeled "① 并发启动（无完成先后要求）" has two blue arrows at the SAME height, Router→P "①a 请求 Prefill" and Router→D "①b 请求准备接收空间". Under each respectively: P local "计算 Prompt KV，生成源 meta"; D local "准备目标 KV 空间，生成目标 meta". Draw P computation as a pale vertical activity bar so it is clear it can finish either side of target registration. Small line nearby "pd_router.cpp:87、90".
Next: blue arrow directly from D at right to P at left, crossing but NOT stopping at Router, labeled "② D 向 P 登记目标 meta"; smaller endpoint "/internal/register-target". Endpoint P below this arrow:
RED ELLIPSE A around yellow P box, text:
"A · P 收到目标 meta"
"JSON 解析与字段校验"
"按传输 ID 查记录，核对完整身份"
"核对目标布局与配对预留"
Code callout beside A: "service.py:238 / pd_service.cpp:55 / pd_service_transfer.cpp:168、177".
Then on P a separate neutral gray box NOT red-circled:
"③ 满足启动条件"
"本地源 meta + 远端目标 meta 均已具备"
"尚未启动，且未取消"
"缺少描述先等待；后到的一方再次触发"
Small citation "pd_service_transfer.cpp:186".
Then a RED ELLIPSE B around P local yellow box:
"B · ④ P 生成拷贝映射"
"同时检查：P 源 meta + D 目标 meta"
"请求 ID、传输 ID、模型一致性"
"源范围覆盖；目标范围缺失或重复"
"失败 → 报错，不提交拷贝"
Code callout to right of B with exact lines:
"入口：pd_service_transfer.cpp:250"
"身份 / 模型：pd_metadata.cpp:109、113"
"目标重复：pd_metadata.cpp:141"
"目标完整性：pd_metadata.cpp:193"
Small note near B "目标重复检查的是 D 的目标区域描述".
Next text above thick GREEN arrow P→D: "⑤ 校验通过且 KV 就绪，P 主动写入 D"
Green arrow passes through Router lifeline without any stop/dot at Router; note below "真实 KV 不经过 Router".
Next thin blue P→D arrow "⑥ 拷贝完成，通知 D"; sublabel "/internal/received · pd_service_transfer.cpp:346".
At D at bottom "⑦ 所需 KV 全部就绪后，D 生成 Token".
Below sequence, independent purple elliptical ring C around lavender box:
"C · JSON 往返一致性：独立测试"
"meta → JSON → meta → 比较是否一致"
"check_protocol.py:280"
"这是测试断言，不是线上额外步骤。"
Footer legend "蓝色：控制消息 / meta    绿色：真实 KV 数据"
Small footer "图示省略 HTTP 响应及 Router 发往 D 的生成请求。"
Avoid suggesting D performs A/B, or serial P-before-D preparation. Check target register arrow direction D→P. Preserve readable hierarchy; use large portrait canvas.
